# member of

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:memberOf`](gmeow-memberOf.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/memberOf>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/organization`](../../slices/organization.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Relates an agent to an organization it belongs to. The flat shortcut ([Principle 4](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-4)); membership propagates up the organizational part/whole hierarchy via the property chain with [`gmeow:subOrganizationOf`](gmeow-subOrganizationOf.md), so a department member is a member of the containing organization. Non-functional and standpoint-indexable — contested memberships coexist ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)). Projects to [schema:memberOf](https://schema.org/memberOf) / [org:memberOf.](http://www.w3.org/ns/org#memberOf.)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for the direct, flat fact that an agent belongs to an organization when role, post, period, and evidence need not be first-class.

### Avoid when

- Avoid it where role or period matter (promote to a [`gmeow:Membership`](../classes/gmeow-Membership.md) relator) and avoid asserting the department-to-parent membership by hand — the property chain with [`gmeow:subOrganizationOf`](gmeow-subOrganizationOf.md) infers it.

### How to use

- Assert one [`gmeow:memberOf`](gmeow-memberOf.md) triple per affiliation; carry contested claims with [`gmeow:accordingTo`](gmeow-accordingTo.md) on the statement, and promote to [`gmeow:Membership`](../classes/gmeow-Membership.md) when the membership itself must bear role, post, or interval.

### Examples

- ex:alice [`gmeow:memberOf`](gmeow-memberOf.md) ex:acme.
